Mirage Prime - Glaive Prime Build

Mirage Prime · by Author One

All-roundSteel PathArchon HuntFarming

Mirage Prime as a buff platform for a heavy-throw Glaive Prime. Mirage stacks damage through Eclipse, Xata's Whisper and Arcane Fury. The Glaive is charge-thrown into a group and detonated mid-air. Toxin and Blast damage, yellow crits and Melee Duplicate do the rest. What matters Max energy above 500: Primed Flow takes Mirage to 641 energy. Only above 500 do the five Violet Archon Shards double their melee crit damage. Primed Flow stays in, even at the cost of efficiency. Yellow crits: Melee Duplicate only makes yellow crits hit a second time. That's why crit chance deliberately stays below 100%. Strength for the buffs: 313% in the arsenal, and more during missions from Growing Power (status effects) and Molt Augmented (stacks with kills, lasts until death). Duration for uptime: Eclipse, Hall of Mirrors and Xata's Whisper last a long time, so you rarely recast. Playstyle Get your buffs up, charge-throw the Glaive, detonate it inside the group, repeat. Kills build Initial Combo through Galvanized Reflex, and Melee Elementalist speeds up the charge. Don't stand still: with around 900 effective health, Mirage can't take much. Roll (Rolling Guard), use the clones as a distraction, and switch Eclipse to damage reduction when needed. Requirements: Melee Arcane Adapter, Galvanized mods and Archon Shards. This is an endgame build.
